        last_data_row = r

# Collect all nonblank subreferences from column D within the actual data rows.
subrefs = [
    str(ws.cell(r, 4).value)
    for r in range(2, last_data_row + 1)
    if ws.cell(r, 4).value is not None
]

# Modify ONLY the requested answer cells F2:F6.

        ref_text = str(ref)
        ws.cell(r, 6).value = sum(1 for subref in subrefs if ref_text in subref)
    else:
        ws.cell(r, 6).value = 0

# Read all SUBREFS values from column D over the actual used range

    val = ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value
    if val is not None:
        subrefs.append(str(val))

# Fill only the requested cells F2:F6
for r in range(2, 7):
    ref = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    status = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value

    if ref is not None and str(status).strip().upper() == "CANCELLED":
        ref_text = str(ref)
        count = sum(1 for subref in subrefs if ref_text in subref)
    else:
        count = 0

    ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value = count
